modules.responsibility: HTTP process entrypoint, listener configuration, and graceful shutdown
bounded public-API workflow checks for local verification
routing, JSON decoding, and stable status mapping
mutex-protected in-memory persistence with copy-on-write commits
concrete dependency wiring for server and workflow checks

workflows.name: Register device
steps: decode and validate the device request
normalize the asset tag and reject a duplicate identity
commit the active device and its audit event
workflows.success: returns the registered device and a readable snapshot
workflows.failure: returns stable validation or duplicate asset-tag errors
workflows.verification: workflowcheck registers a device, reads it, and rejects a duplicate tag

workflows.name: Open verification case
steps: verify the device exists and is active
reject a second unfinished case for the same device
open one waiting case with a nominal value and tolerance
workflows.failure: returns not-found or active-case conflict errors
workflows.verification: workflowcheck opens and reads a case, then rejects a concurrent second case

workflows.name: Record measurement
steps: load the waiting case and compute signed deviation
accept an in-tolerance measurement or require a repeat
commit the measurement and case transition together
workflows.success: returns a review_ready or recheck_required case
workflows.failure: returns conflict when the case is not awaiting measurement
workflows.verification: workflowcheck records both accepted and rejected measurements

workflows.name: Reopen verification case
steps: verify the case is in recheck_required
record the actor and reason
return the case to awaiting_measurement
workflows.success: returns the reopened case and a new audit event
workflows.failure: returns conflict for any other case state
workflows.verification: workflowcheck fails a measurement, reopens the case, and rejects a second reopen

workflows.name: Seal verification
steps: verify the case is ready for review
select the accepted measurement with the smallest deviation
create exactly one seal and make the case terminal
workflows.success: returns a sealed case and one evidence seal
workflows.failure: returns conflict for a non-reviewable case or a duplicate seal
workflows.verification: workflowcheck races two seal requests and verifies exactly one succeeds

workflows.name: Open multi-checkpoint case
steps: verify the device exists, is active, and has no unfinished case
validate the ordered checkpoint plan: unique codes and labels, positive tolerances
open one awaiting case with one pending checkpoint per planned point
workflows.success: returns an awaiting_measurement case carrying the full ordered point plan
workflows.failure: rejects empty, duplicated, or malformed plans with invalid_input
workflows.verification: workflowcheck opens a three-point case, reads it back, rejects bad plans, and confirms the legacy single-point contract synthesizes one default checkpoint

workflows.name: Record checkpoint results
steps: resolve the planned point and evaluate the observed value against its own nominal and tolerance
reject repeat records on a decided point and records on an un-reopened failed case
derive aggregate state from point decisions, staying open until every point passes
workflows.success: closes one point per request and reaches review_ready only after all points pass
workflows.verification: workflowcheck closes points sequentially, rejects duplicates and unknown points, races two technicians on one pending point with exactly one winner, and closes distinct points in parallel

workflows.name: Rework failed checkpoint
steps: reset only failed checkpoints to pending while passed points keep their evidence
preserve every measurement attempt and the cumulative attempt count
record the retry against the same plan and close the package when it passes
workflows.success: returns an awaiting case whose failed points are remeasurable and passed points are untouched
workflows.failure: returns state_conflict for a second reopen or reopening from any other state
workflows.verification: workflowcheck fails one point, reopens, verifies passed points and failed history survive, retries the point, and confirms the attempt count

workflows.name: Seal multi-checkpoint package
steps: reject sealing while any checkpoint is pending or failed
freeze one sealed checkpoint per planned point with its measurement basis
create exactly one seal under concurrent reviewer requests
workflows.success: returns a sealed case whose seal cites the closing measurement of every point
workflows.failure: returns state_conflict for an incomplete package or seal_exists for a repeat
workflows.verification: workflowcheck blocks premature seals, races two sealers with exactly one winner, cross-checks every frozen point against the case, and rejects post-seal mutation

complexity.notes: Case aggregate state is derived from immutable checkpoint decisions; case changes and audit events commit atomically under one repository mutation lock, so duplicate point records, premature or concurrent sealing, and unguarded rework are deterministic. Failed attempts and their measurements are retained across reopen so the final seal cites traceable evidence for every point.
